description: A community health department administrator must approve one Saturday mobile vaccination clinic site and finalize its vaccine formulation, cold-chain arrangement, and appointment operations, with input from public health nursing, pharmacy logistics, and community outreach.

shared_context.S1: The hospital's community health department has one Saturday mobile vaccination clinic available this month.
shared_context.S2: The clinic can operate at either the Eastside Community Center or the Westside Library.
shared_context.S3: Marisol makes the final activation decision and signs the operational plan.
shared_context.S4: The mobile team can provide routine adult vaccination and pediatric vaccination when the required formulation and site arrangements are documented.
shared_context.S5: At the weekly readiness huddle, the administrator asks public health nursing, pharmacy logistics, and community outreach to report their clinical, supply, and access requirements before the site is approved.

PF1.text: The county's current allocation list records 31 children aged six months through four years in the Eastside service area, and county policy requires the Saturday session serving that group to use the pediatric mRNA formulation at Eastside Community Center; Evan received the updated list from the county nurse coordinator this morning.

PF2.text: Eastside Community Center has a validated vaccine refrigerator with capacity for 80 doses at 2-8 degrees Celsius, and pharmacy policy requires an opening temperature-log check at 08:00 before any doses are released there; Nadia verified the refrigerator record with facilities.

PF3.text: Eastside Community Center's partner organization has confirmed 48 appointments beginning at 09:00 on Saturday, with an American Sign Language interpreter reserved for that session; Theo received the confirmation from the partner's program director.

acceptance_conditions: The Saturday mobile clinic must be activated at Eastside Community Center.
The vaccine formulation must be documented as pediatric mRNA or pediatric mRNA formulation.
The vaccine storage range must be documented as 2-8 degrees Celsius with an 08:00 temperature-log check.
The operational plan must record 48 appointments beginning at 09:00 on Saturday and an American Sign Language interpreter reserved for the session.
The county pediatric allocation requirement must be cited as justification for the site and formulation.

content_checks.C4: decisions['appointment_count'] == 48 and decisions['appointment_start_time'] == '09:00' and decisions['asl_interpreter_reserved'] == True
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['outreach_appointment_block', 'appointment_scheduling', 'access_accommodation', 'access', 'clinic_operations'] and c['target'] in ['Eastside Community Center', 'Eastside Community Center partner organization', 'Community outreach', 'Public health nursing'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The county list of 31 young children and its site-specific policy changes the site to Eastside Community Center and the formulation to pediatric mRNA, while supplying the clinical-policy basis that must be cited.
The validated Eastside refrigerator changes the cold-chain plan to 2-8 degrees Celsius with an exact 08:00 temperature-log check rather than leaving storage and release controls unspecified.
The partner's confirmed 48 appointments, 09:00 start, and reserved American Sign Language interpreter change the operational plan to exact appointment and accessibility commitments.
